answer: Proof of Burn provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to permanently destroy digital assets to register, effectively creating a mesa of high entry barriers. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces a cost equivalent to the copper needed for hardware infrastructure and the capital inlet required to fund the burnt tokens. This economic friction ensures that malicious scalability is prohibitively expensive, forcing agents to prioritize longevity and resource efficiency over sheer volume.
